aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer, described in the abstract as cases diagnosed as advanced cancer
aggressive_definition_excerpt: During 14 years of follow-up from 1986 through 2000, 2901 new cases of prostate cancer were ascertained, of which 434 cases were diagnosed as advanced cancer.
study_design: Prospective cohort analysis in the Health Professionals Follow-Up Study
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We examined the association between supplemental zinc intake and prostate cancer risk among 46 974 U.S. men participating in the Health Professionals Follow-Up Study.
reason: The cohort analysis reports both total incident prostate cancer and an explicitly advanced incident endpoint. The supplied zinc estimate is specifically for advanced prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: However, compared with nonusers, men who consumed more than 100 mg/day of supplemental zinc had a relative risk of advanced prostate cancer of 2.29 (95% confidence interval = 1.06 to 4.95; P(trend) =.003), and men who took supplemental zinc for 10 or more years had a relative risk of 2.37 (95% confidence interval = 1.42 to 3.95; P(trend)<.001).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly measures the risk of incident advanced prostate cancer for more than 100 mg/day of supplemental zinc versus nonuse.
